description: Implementation of the BitTube class for inter-process communication via socket pairs, including socket setup, data transmission, and parcel serialization.

classes.name: BitTube
classes.description: A class managing socket-based communication channels with parcelable file descriptors.

methods.name: BitTube
methods.description: Constructors for initializing BitTube with buffer size, default size, or parcel data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes socket pair with specified receive and send buffer sizes.

methods.name: initCheck
methods.description: Checks if the socket file descriptor is valid.

methods.name: moveReceiveFd
methods.description: Transfers ownership of the receive file descriptor.

methods.name: writeToParcel
methods.description: Serializes file descriptors into a parcel.

methods.name: readFromParcel
methods.description: Deserializes file descriptors from a parcel.

methods.name: sendObjects
methods.description: Sends multiple objects over the socket.

methods.name: recvObjects
methods.description: Receives multiple objects over the socket.
